scores.evidence: The 3 objectives use observable verbs (まとめられる / 判断できる / 説明できる). Each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q2, q3, e1 and e2; o2 has q1, q5, q6 and e3; o3 has q4, e5 and e6. Both e1 (team sharing) and e3 (finding old code before swapping a library) are apply-or-higher transfer items. The create level of o1 is checked only by pr-checklist (「説明文に「何をするか」と「いつ使うか」が書いてあります」).

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「コミットの前に、毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか。」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」). The second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The prerequisites name lessons 5 and 6, and the text recalls them where they are used (「（第6回）」 in s1-lead and hook-q, 「（第5回）」 in s3-lead). The new terms are defined with their English in s1-defs (スキル, フロントマター, 段階的な読み込み) and s3-defs (サブエージェント, フォーク), and 拡張機能 is defined in s4-lead. These definitions match the glossary. YAML is glossed inline (「「項目名: 値」の形で設定を書く書式」).

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict gives 0 errors and 0 warnings. Section 7-3 is the densest: subagent, fork, background default and the agent file come in 7 blocks before its check. The unexplained `>-` sentence in ex-description also adds load.

7-2 is a full worked example before practice. s2-steps has 5 labelled steps, each with its reason (「起動後に `.claude/skills/` を新しく作ると、`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです」, 「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」), plus a prediction in ex-auto. There is no faded example. The subagent half of the practice is shown only as s3-how's one-line phrasing.

Every content section has an inline quiz, and q1, q3, q4 and q5 need inference. But q6 (bloom evaluate) can be solved by matching words from s4-table right above it: 「Claudeが2回まちがえた」 vs 「Claudeが2回まちがえたら」, 「毎週チャットに貼っている」 vs 「何度も貼っている」, 「出力が会話にあふれた」 vs 「出力が会話にあふれる」. q2's answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors whose feedback corrects them in 2 sentences or fewer. Examples: q2 b (「説明文に書いたお願いは、確実に止めるしくみではありません。」), q4 c (「ゼロではありませんが、ふつうはファイルの中身よりずっと小さくなります。」), q5 b, e2 a (「使うかどうかの判断には、説明文が使われます。」) and q6 d. s4-pitfall names the 「最初に全部そろえる」 mistake.

s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram (4 nodes) show a process, and their captions state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」). There are no decorative images. But the s1-diagram labels say 「読む」 while the lesson's term is 読み込む (段階的な読み込み). Its alt also describes a branch the diagram does not draw (「それ以外では本文は読み込まれない」), and that is the contrast q1 tests.

The task is authentic: the learner turns their own repeated work into a skill, then compares `/context` before and after delegating. All 7 pr-steps have an expect, pr-prompt gives the delegation text, pr-checklist sets 5 success criteria and pr-model/pr-model-lead give a model answer with its reason. pr-write has only one hint rung (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に、中身を入れ替えます。」) before the full model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ挙げてみましょう」) and names the next lesson by its exact title. It is followed by 6 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions.

The 4 confirmed findings in audit-cc-07-skills-subagents.json are all applied: q5 d (「スキルはふだん今の会話の中で動くため、脇では進みません。」), q2 d (「フロントマターなどの設定で決めます」), e6 c (「主に」), and the s4 caption is gone. s4-main matches sub-agents.md ("A subagent that isn't a fork starts fresh and may need time to gather context"), and the versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198). Not scored 4: nothing shows that the folded `description: >-` in s2-skill, s3-file and pr-model loads as written. The saved pages show no folded description, and the commit-message folder in audit-repro-cc-07-skills-subagents is empty.

The text uses です・ます and is warm (「まず予想してみましょう」), and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. Katakana terms carry their English on first use (サブエージェント（subagent）, バックグラウンド（background）). Minor inconsistency: s1-diagram's 「読む」 vs 「読み込まれる」 in the text. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The lesson is jp only and complete, including the diagram labels. Both diagrams have alt text, and the s2-legacy link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメント（日本語版）」). s4-table is a semantic list of self-contained sentences that fits mobile.

mustFix.issue: q6 (o2, bloom evaluate) can be answered by matching words, which breaks contract §4 (「not recognition of the sentence just read」). Each option paraphrases the s4-table item or s4-pitfall title shown just above it: a 「Claudeが2回まちがえた」, b 「チャットに貼っている」, c 「出力が会話にあふれた」, d 「最初に全部」. A learner can find the answer by searching for 「貼っている」 without judging which tool fits.
mustFix.fix: In q6, keep the ids, the order, the answer (b) and the existing feedback for a, c and d, and rewrite the option text so it describes each situation without the list's wording. a: 「決まったテストのコマンドではなく、別のコマンドをClaudeが今日も実行した」. b: 「リリース前の12ステップの確認を、毎週チャットで一から説明し直している」. c: 「ログの原因調査を頼んだら、もう読まない出力で会話の大半が埋まった」. d: 「まだ困っていないが、思いつく作業を今のうちにすべてスキルにしておく」.

niceToHave: factual doubt: none of the saved official pages (skills.md, sub-agents.md) shows a folded `description: >-`, and the commit-message folder in audit-repro-cc-07-skills-subagents is empty. Reproduce s2-skill once in cc-practice and confirm that `/commit-message` appears and loads. If it does not, use single-line descriptions in s2-skill, s3-file and pr-model.

hook-predict: add a second ungraded prediction for the other problem in hook-b1, e.g. 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」

s2-check q2: the answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it. To make it less of a recall item, consider asking which of three skills (deploy-prod, summarize-changes, test-report) should get `disable-model-invocation: true`.
s3-file-lead: `tools: Read, Grep, Glob` is not explained, but e6 d relies on it (「読み取り用にしぼっていた」). Change the end to 「`tools` でツールをしぼれます（例は、読み取りと検索だけ）。」

summary: Full review: the earlier review chain was recorded under the old vibe-coding/drafts path, and the content (lessonHash sha256:f8e6497346002dd9) has not changed since. Validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min」. The lesson's strengths are a well-reasoned worked example in 7-2, distractors built from real misconceptions with corrective feedback, and an authentic practice task with a checklist and a model answer. One must-fix remains: q6, the only inline evaluate item for o2, can be answered by matching words from s4-table. Rewrite its options as given above. Every criterion scores 3 or more and the mean is 3.38, so the verdict is revise only because of this item.
